core_obligations: Beyond the already-collected Kirillov annihilation projector, the proof identifies the Kostant-Whittaker monoidal trivialization with a constant rational Cremmer-Gervais quantization and constructs a Miura-compatible tensor natural isomorphism giving the vertex-IRF gauge. The degenerate affine Hecke/vector-representation calculation and tensor compatibility are not supplied by ordinary extremal-projector existence.
